## What this changes

## Type
- [ ] Cosmetic (typo, wording) — no rubric version bump
- [ ] Rubric change (weight or pass condition) — **needs a rubric proposal issue first**
- [ ] Reference material
- [ ] Other

## For rubric changes
Linked proposal issue: #
Version bumped to: `rubric/v___.md` (never edit a released rubric in place)

## Checklist
- [ ] No fix templates, remediation steps or content-rewriting rules added
      (see [Scope](../README.md#scope--what-this-does-not-do))
- [ ] Claims that rest on observation rather than published research say so
